description: Launch a fine-tune/training run on the buyer's chosen compute provider (Fireworks now; Together/Baseten/Modal/RunPod/Nebius/Replicate/OpenAI as adapters land): verified OpenTrain data (synthetic run, graded project, or inline rows) trains a model on THEIR key and bill; status/cost/model-handle recorded; training_run.status_changed webhooks fire on transitions. Requires compute:write.

baseModel.description: A base model id from the provider descriptor.

maxSpendUsd.description: Hard-cancel threshold on your own provider bill.

objective.description: SFT trains on verified rows; RFT trains against the human-reward evaluator derived from graded rubric scores.

provider.description: Compute provider id from opentrain_compute_providers (e.g. FIREWORKS).

source.description: Training data source: {kind: SYNTHETIC_RUN, runId} (verified rows) | {kind: WORK_PROJECT, projectId} (human-corrected/graded rows; required for RFT) | {kind: INLINE, records: [{messages:[...]}]}.

name: opentrain_compute_launch_training
